blocks.text: Amie Provido shone the brightest for Alas Pilipinas Women tonight, unloading a game-high 19 points on 11 attacks, four blocks, and four aces in Philippines' 25-8, 25-2, 25-9 dismantling of Qatar in the classification round of the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Games, Sunday.
